text: So Ne-Yo made headlines after an interview where he talks about being in a polyamorous relationship with three women. And if you don't know who Ne-Yo is, you are either way too young or you were living under a rock in the late 2000s. He was a superstar. His songs were playing everywhere. But let's actually go to the interview. You are in a polyamorous relationship with three women. Yes. I made the decision that I was never going to tell another lie to a woman ever again in life. One of the three I've been with a little longer than the other one. So I basically went to her and said, listen, you know, I rock with you. You know, I love you. But I have to be honest with you. It's not just you. I would love for you to meet these other women. And if we can figure out a way to do something together, cool. If not, that's cool, too. Everybody chose to stick around. Can they date other men? No. No. And no is why? I've made no request for exclusivity of any of these women. I've never said if it ain't me, it ain't nothing. I've never said that. I didn't ask for them to be with me. They said they want to be with me. OK, they gave me their exclusivity, meaning if you gave it to me, it's mine. Oh, Neo, Neo, I guess you are so sick of love songs. You can imagine how much hate he got in the comments, especially from women. Look, I'm not here to moralize. People can live their lives however they want. If a guy wants to date three women and all of them are OK with it, everything is consensual. Everyone is an adult. Kudos to them. No problem. But Neo's mistake is that he went public with it and kind of tried to defend that idea of a relationship, also claiming that it is based on radical honesty. Come on, man, this is not radical honesty. This is simply one woman is not enough for you. Your 2023 divorce was based on chronic infidelities and fathering a child with another woman. So what kind of radical honesty are you talking about? Radical honesty would be if you came out and said, look, I am freaking Neo. I am rich and famous. And a lot of women want to be with me. That is why I can have this one-sided relationship, where I can sleep with several people, but these three women can only sleep with me. And by the way, I wouldn't be surprised if he is also allowed to sleep with other women on the site, besides these three. Look, guys, on my channel, I am trying to communicate approaches to life that are more fair and less hypocritical. If you want to be with two, three, four women at the same time, it is your choice. But keep it as fair and ecological as possible. Don't promise relationships you can't deliver. Don't sell fantasies. Be honest. We are having a good time, but we do not owe anything to each other. You can do what you want. I can do what I want. That is it. And then later, if you really find someone who truly seems to be the one for you, you can go exclusive and try to build a great relationship with her. This, in my opinion, is how you can structure your life without sounding hypocritical like Neo. Sorry, Neo, love your music, but this is my opinion.
